mapper.select: select psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID,info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_ID, psv.INV_AIM, psv.CCY, psv.SHARE_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT, psv.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE, psv.BUY_COST_AMT, psv.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE,psv.MARKET_VALUE, psv.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP,psv.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD,psv.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD,psv.TDY_FEE_ADD,psv.CREATE_USER,psv.CREATE_DEPT,psv.CREATE_TIME,psv.UPDATE_USER, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, fpv.VALUATION ACCU_NET_VALUE/*场外金融产品估值*/ from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join REP_ASSET_DEPT info on info.REP_FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpv on fpv.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fpv.VAL_DATE = psv.CDATE where psv.CDATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) union /*查询母资管计划的估值信息*/ select psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID,info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FINPROD_ID, psv.INV_AIM, max(psv.CCY), sum(psv.SHARE_AMT), sum(psv.DSC_COST_AMT), sum(psv.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE), sum(psv.BUY_COST_AMT), sum(psv.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE),sum(psv.MARKET_VALUE), sum(psv.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE),sum(psv.TDY_INTINCEXP),sum(psv.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD), sum(psv.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD),sum(psv.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD), sum(psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD),sum(psv.TDY_FEE_ADD),max(psv.CREATE_USER),max(psv.CREATE_DEPT),max(psv.CREATE_TIME),max(psv.UPDATE_USER), max(ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME, sum(fpv.VALUATION) ACCU_NET_VALUE/*场外金融产品估值*/ from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT product on product.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F17' left join REP_ASSET_DEPT info on info.REP_FINPROD_ID = ifnull(product.P_FINPROD_ID,product.FINPROD_ID) left join FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION fpv on fpv.FINPROD_ID = info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID and fpv.VAL_DATE = psv.CDATE where psv.CDATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) group by psv.CDATE,psv.PORTFOLIO_ID,info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, psv.INV_AIM

select distinct cdate from ( select CDATE cdate from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} union all select VAL_DATE cdate from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ) order by cdate
